$description: Wave 5 DTCG source. Primitive layer holds mode-invariant raw values; semantic layer maps those primitives per color mode. Cream paper base plus the portfolio trio: coral primary accent ramp (8 steps, the amp/tone knob), periwinkle support-1 and mint support-2 (fixed). Punch is the default component voice (2px ink borders, hard offset shadow on Button/Card/Badge); quiet ships as the opt-in [data-voice=quiet] wrapper.

primitive.$description: Mode-invariant raw values. Never consume directly in components; go through semantic aliases.

200.$description: Pale pink. Dark-mode accent-strong (hover fill and text); passes AA on dark paper.

300.$description: Coral core. Primary accent fill both modes; plum text on top passes AA.

400.$description: Deep coral. Amp step for the accent knob; plum text on top still passes AA.

500.$description: Mid berry. Text-safe on light paper and on accent-soft.

600.$description: Deep berry. Text-safe on light paper and on accent-soft.

700.$description: Darkest berry. Light-mode accent-strong: hover fill (cream text on top) and text on paper or soft.

accent.$description: Coral primary ramp. THE accent knob: remap semantic accent tokens one step along this ramp. Never introduce a hue outside the trio; supports stay fixed.

border.$description: Border widths. Hairlines for quiet precision, punch for the default voice.

hairline.$description: Quiet borders, fields, overlays, table chrome.

font.$description: Two families maximum. Bricolage Grotesque for headlines, Inter for body. Both OFL, loaded via Fontsource variable packages.

ink.$description: Plum neutral text scale shared by both modes.

500.$description: Light-mode secondary (muted) text. Passes AA on cream paper.

line.$description: Quiet border colors, one per mode.

dark.$description: Quiet border on dark plum paper.

motion.$description: Single timing pair for lift/press feedback. Always pair with the reduced-motion fallback in theme.css.

paper.$description: Cream paper scale. 50/100 serve light mode, 800/900 serve dark mode.

radius.$description: Round-flat radius scale. Pills fully round, cards crisp at 8px, slabs one step up. Punch cards sit at 12px.

card.$description: Cards and default interactive surfaces. Quiet voice.

pill.$description: Pills, badges, toggle tracks. Effectively fully round.

shadow.$description: The single soft elevation, for quiet surfaces and overlays.

soft.$description: Lifted quiet surfaces, modal panels, popovers.

support-1.$description: Periwinkle support. Fixed; the accent knob never moves it.

soft.$description: Periwinkle tint. Plum text on top passes AA both modes.

solid.$description: Periwinkle fill. Plum text on top passes AA both modes.

support-2.$description: Mint support. Fixed; the accent knob never moves it.

soft.$description: Mint tint. Plum text on top passes AA both modes.

solid.$description: Mint fill. Plum text on top passes AA both modes.

semantic.$description: Mode-paired aliases. Every entry exists in both light and dark; components consume only these.

dark.$description: Dark-mode semantic mapping over primitives. Same token names as light.

accent.$description: Accent fills. ACCENT KNOB: point at accent 200 to amp, accent 400 to tone.

accent-soft.$description: Tinted accent background with accent-strong text on top.

accent-strong.$description: Accent hover fill (dark-plum text on top) and accent text on paper.

support-1.$description: Periwinkle fill. Pair with accent-ink text.

support-1-soft.$description: Periwinkle tint. Pair with accent-ink text.

support-2.$description: Mint fill. Pair with accent-ink text.

support-2-soft.$description: Mint tint. Pair with accent-ink text.

accent.$description: Accent fills. ACCENT KNOB: point at accent 400 to amp, accent 200 to tone.

accent-soft.$description: Tinted accent background with accent-strong text on top.

accent-strong.$description: Accent hover fill (cream text on top) and accent text on paper. Darker than the Wave 4 preview value so resting and hover both pass AA.

support-1.$description: Periwinkle fill. Pair with accent-ink text.

support-1-soft.$description: Periwinkle tint. Pair with accent-ink text.

support-2.$description: Mint fill. Pair with accent-ink text.

support-2-soft.$description: Mint tint. Pair with accent-ink text.
